title: 第7章 各方反应第8章 气血丹的消息
slug: 打造万古家族开局奖励极道帝兵
lines: 东江郑氏，白河县传承了五百多年的世家豪族，光是明面上，就有三位气血境修士坐镇。
是名副其实的白河县第一大家族。
家主书房内。
郑家家主郑灵君神情凝重的看着手中的急报，不由得倒吸了一口凉气。
慵懒的躺在睡椅上的郑家老祖看着郑灵君这个样子，打趣道：“天崩了，还是地陷了，能让我堂堂郑家的家主如此失态。”
郑灵君摇了摇头。
“都不是，就在刚才，李家出手，灭掉了邹、张、金三家与大刀门，牵连者数千人。”
闻言。
郑家老祖白眉一挑，笑着道：“我还以为是什么大事呢？据老头子所知，这几家的实力还算不错，李家的李玄风不是死了吗，还有实力同时灭掉这四家？莫非是李玄通那小子突破到气血境了？即便如此，区区一个气血境，也不应该让我郑家的家主如此失态才是啊。”
郑灵君苦笑一声，摊着手道：“李家确实是又有了新的气血境，不过不是李玄通。”
“不是李玄通，还能是谁？”
郑家老祖有些诧异。
“李行歌。”
郑家老祖想了半天，突然，眼睛一瞪，吹着胡子道：“你曾经跟我说过的李家那个小辈？”
“不错。
郑灵君点了点头。
郑家老祖神情一滞。
半晌后，才击了击掌哈哈大笑道：“好.....好......好，真是长江后浪推前浪，后生可畏，后生可畏啊。”
“十七岁的气血境修士，真是难以想象，其天赋到底有多恐怖，可惜了，如此天才，竟不是生在我郑家，若是我郑家子弟，有此子在，定能恢复祖上荣光。”
郑灵君的言语间有些唏嘘和艳羡，同时，还有着一丝潜藏在眼底深处的忌惮。
恰好，这一丝忌惮便被郑家老祖给精准的捕捉到。
“怎么，害怕了？”
知道自己的小心思没有瞒过自家老祖。
郑灵君毫不掩饰的点了点头：“没错，这个李行歌，太妖孽了，若是再给他十年时间，我郑家白河县第一家族的名头怕是保不住了。”
“所以呢？趁其没有成长起来，杀掉他？”
郑家老祖依旧一脸笑意的道。
郑灵君想了想，摇了摇头：“孩儿没有十足的把握。”
“既然没有把握，那就收起你心中的那些小心思。”
郑家老祖收起了脸上的笑意，神情罕见的变得严肃了起来。
他慢悠悠的从睡椅上站起身来：“灵君，你知道为什么在白河县，只有我郑家，能延续五百年吗？”
不等郑灵君回答，他便自顾自的道：“并不是因为我郑家够强，曾经的郭家，姚家，哪一个不比我郑家强？可现在呢？他们在哪？早已身死族灭。”
“也不是因为我郑家先祖出身于灵虚门，有灵虚门庇佑，要知道，情分总有用完的一天。”
“是因为小心，谨慎，没有把握的事，从不去做。”
“这个世界上，总有一些受上天眷顾的人，他们天赋异禀，气运冲霄，别人要走几十年上百年的路，他们只需要短短的几年便能走完。”
“每一次不能击败他们的，都会使他们更强大，那些曾经站在他们对立面的，都会被他们踩在脚下，成为更进一步的垫脚石。”
郑灵君瞪大了眼。
惊讶道：“老祖，你的意思是这个李行歌就是这样的人？”
郑家老祖摇了摇头。
“我也不确定。”
郑灵君皱了皱眉，有些不解。
content_en:
The Dongjiang Zheng family is a wealthy family in Baihe County that has been inherited for more than 500 years. On the surface, there are three Qi and Blood Realm monks in charge.
It is truly the largest family in Baihe County.
In the master's study.
The head of the Zheng family, Zheng Lingjun, looked at the urgent report in his hand with a solemn expression and couldn't help but take a breath.
aside...
The ancestor of the Zheng family, who was lazily lying on the couch, looked at Zheng Lingjun like this and joked: "If the sky collapses, the earth will sink. How can I, the head of the Zheng family, be so rude?"
Zheng Lingjun shook his head.
"No, just now, the Li family took action and wiped out the Zou, Zhang, Jin families and the Dadao Clan, implicating thousands of people."
Hear the words.
The ancestor of the Zheng family raised his white eyebrows and said with a smile: "I thought it was some big deal? As far as the old man knows, the strength of these families is pretty good. Isn't Li Xuanfeng of the Li family dead? Isn't he still capable of destroying these four families at the same time? Could it be that boy Li Xuantong has broken through to the Qi-blood realm? Even so, a mere Qi-blood realm should not make me, the head of the Zheng family, so rude."
Zheng Lingjun smiled bitterly, spread his hands and said, "The Li family does have a new Qi and Blood Realm, but it's not Li Xuantong."
"If it's not Li Xuantong, who else could it be?"
The ancestor of the Zheng family was a little surprised.
"Li Xingge."
The ancestor of the Zheng family thought for a long time. Suddenly, his eyes widened and he blew his beard and said, "That junior of the Li family you once told me about?"
"Not bad.
Zheng Lingjun nodded.
The ancestor of the Zheng family was stunned.
After a long while, he high-fived and laughed loudly: "Okay...Okay...Okay, it's true that the waves behind the Yangtze River push the waves ahead, and those who come after us are to be feared, and those who come after us are to be feared." "
"It is really unimaginable how terrifying the talent of a seventeen-year-old monk in the Qi and Blood Realm is. It is a pity that such a genius was not born into my Zheng family. If he were a descendant of my Zheng family, with this son, he would definitely be able to restore the glory of his ancestors. "
Zheng Lingjun's words were filled with regret and envy, and at the same time, there was also a hint of fear hidden deep in his eyes.
Coincidentally, this trace of fear was accurately captured by the ancestor of the Zheng family.
"What, are you scared? "
I know that my little thoughts have not been hidden from my ancestor.
Zheng Lingjun nodded unabashedly: "Yes, this Li Xingge is too evil. If he is given another ten years, my Zheng family may not be able to keep their reputation as the first family in Baihe County. "
"so what? Kill him before he grows up? "
The ancestor of the Zheng family still said with a smile on his face.
Zheng Lingjun thought for a while and shook his head: "My child is not completely sure. "
"Since you are not sure, then put away those little thoughts in your heart. "
The ancestor of the Zheng family put away the smile on his face, and his expression became rarely serious.
He slowly stood up from the couch: "Lingjun, do you know why in Baihe County, only my Zheng family can last for five hundred years? "
Without waiting for Zheng Lingjun to answer, he said to himself: "It's not because our Zheng family is strong enough. Which of the former Guo family and Yao family is not stronger than my Zheng family? But now? Where are they? Already dead and his family extinct. "
"It's not because my ancestors of the Zheng family were born in the Lingxu Sect and were protected by the Lingxu Sect. You know, love will eventually run out. "
“It’s because I’m careful, cautious, and never do anything I’m not sure about. "
"In this world, there are always some people who are favored by God. They are talented and lucky. It only takes them a few years to complete a journey that takes decades or hundreds of years for others. "
“Every time those who fail to defeat them will make them stronger, and those who once stood against them will be stepped on by them and become stepping stones to go further. "
Zheng Lingjun's eyes widened.
Surprised: "Ancestor, do you mean that this Li Xingge is this kind of person? "
The ancestor of the Zheng family shook his head.
"I'm not sure either. "
Zheng Lingjun frowned, a little confused.
"Then why..."
